technical-summary: The forced placement driver's engine-serving gate (#718) read Header::publish_sequence, which the lane request path never sets, so on flashnext-4gpu KL runs the gate never opened (attempted=0). It now opens when any lane's done_sequence is nonzero (written only after the helper completes a request the engine routed to it). Test: publish_sequence alone does not open the gate; a completed request on any lane does.
user-summary-candidate: Forced expert-churn test runs swap experts again: they start once the helpers have completed the engine's first request.
